says: Cho owns a personal instructions source whose rights allow read and use only. Ana founds a Team, Ben joins it by invitation, verified key and consent, and Ana issues Ben a grant under her founder grant limited to the service repository, for read, use, contribute and grant, with a delegation ceiling of 1. Ben then tries three child grants for Cho naming his grant as parent: one adding publish, which his grant does not hold; one scoped to the whole Team rather than the repository; and one with a delegation ceiling of 1, which his own ceiling does not leave room for. Each is refused with delegation_ceiling_exceeded. Ana, acting for the Team under its policy, sets rights on Cho's source that would allow derive and export, and is refused with source_right_not_overridable. Asking the owner by request id afterwards returns the refused results themselves, with no receipt: nothing was committed and no head moved.
